title.narrative: Support to the Rule of Law and Fundamental Rights Sector in Montenegro - Application of Unique Information System of Judiciary

description.narrative: The Project Support to the Rule of Law and Fundamental Rights Sector in Montenegro - Application of Unique Information System of Judiciary is designed to contribute to the enhancement of the Rule of Law system by increasing efficiency and effectiveness of the institutions and to bring the system for promotion and protection of human rights in line with the best EU practices.\nIn order to improve ICT systems in all subsystems of the Judiciary, compliant with the European Commission for the Efficiency of Justice (CEPEJ) standards, and enhance the technical capacity of the institutions implementing the Action Plans for the EU Accession Chapters 23 and 24,.
